source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRURM WHERE H = 'D'

select 
				 [USER_ID]
				,[USER_NAME]

				,[MOBILE_NO]

				,[SUB_BRANCH_CODE]

				,[STATUS]
				,[REJECT_REASON]

				,[ADDRESS_3]
				,[ADDRESS_4]
				,[CITY]
				,[ZIPCODE]
				,[COUNTRY]
				,[PHONE_RES]
				,[PHONE_OFF]
				,[PHONE_OTHER]
				,[FAX_NUMBER]
				,[EMAIL_2]
				,[SUPERVISOR_UNIT_CODE]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ROLE_ID]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ID]
				,[DEF_BRANCH]
				,[DEF_SUBBRANCH]
				,[JOINING_DATE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [USER_ID]
				,[USER_NAME]
				,[DEF_LANG]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[MOBILE_NO]
				,[BRANCH_CODE]
				,[SUB_BRANCH_CODE]
				,[USER_LEVEL]
				,[SENS_REQ_FLAG]
				,[SERVICE_GROUP_ID]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[STATUS]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[ADDRESS_1]
				,[ADDRESS_2]
				,[ADDRESS_3]
				,[ADDRESS_4]
				,[CITY]
				,[ZIPCODE]
				,[COUNTRY]
				,[PHONE_RES]
				,[PHONE_OFF]
				,[PHONE_OTHER]
				,[FAX_NUMBER]
				,[EMAIL_2]
				,[SUPERVISOR_UNIT_CODE]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ROLE_ID]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ID]
				,[DEF_BRANCH]
				,[DEF_SUBBRANCH]
				,[JOINING_DATE]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRURM_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [USER_ID]
				,[USER_NAME]
				,[DEF_LANG]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[MOBILE_NO]
				,[BRANCH_CODE]
				,[SUB_BRANCH_CODE]
				,[USER_LEVEL]
				,[SENS_REQ_FLAG]
				,[SERVICE_GROUP_ID]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[STATUS]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[ADDRESS_1]
				,[ADDRESS_2]
				,[ADDRESS_3]
				,[ADDRESS_4]
				,[CITY]
				,[ZIPCODE]
				,[COUNTRY]
				,[PHONE_RES]
				,[PHONE_OFF]
				,[PHONE_OTHER]
				,[FAX_NUMBER]
				,[EMAIL_2]
				,[SUPERVISOR_UNIT_CODE]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ROLE_ID]
				,[SUPERVISOR_ID]
				,[DEF_BRANCH]
				,[DEF_SUBBRANCH]
				,[JOINING_DATE]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_TRURM]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_TRURM A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRURM_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.USER_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.USER_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRURM_GROUP_SRC SRC
